source_snapshot.criteria: Both list forms and Web match SPEC; numbering is 1, 2, 77.
source_snapshot.script: No Script; Config-Check; 3/0 minutes; unique code.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES/ipmitool with synthetic REDUNDANCY_PSU sensor-get and truncated OOB fallback.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; records the AMBIENT/TEMP_MB conflict and separates passive redundancy status from functional failover.

old_problem: The item is PSU redundancy, yet the IB and OOB filters target unrelated AMBIENT and TEMP_MB thermal names. No PSU slot/feed/redundancy topology, authoritative group/member records or state decoder is supplied, and DeepSeek invents one possible label. A passive status row also cannot prove failover/load sharing; criteria jump from 2 to 77.
disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict in the Review layer without editing Master: preserve AMBIENT/TEMP_MB as recorded source defects and prohibit using them as PSU evidence absent an explicit mapping; discover and bind the actual redundancy-group and per-PSU records from approved Project topology. DMTF Redfish standardizes power-supply redundancy groups and member links as an optional corroborating view, while OEM/IPMI record names remain unguessed. ED-03 permits runtime topology binding, ED-13 governs absent members, and ED-09 keeps any physical failover outside this passive row.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2033, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, ED-01 through ED-30 and DMTF Redfish power-subsystem redundancy semantics were reviewed; next row was directly opened as Functionality 2034 / Wistron-BMC-01053-V002 / 26f07df4844dd8c4.
AMBIENT and TEMP_MB are not accepted as redundancy evidence unless the signed Project map explicitly proves an unusual alias; both original commands remain traceable as defects.

The passive objective is recoverable from Items: enumerate redundancy group policy/mode and every PSU slot/module/feed/member health across complete IB/OOB/Web evidence, optionally corroborated by standard Redfish PowerSupplyRedundancy.

Reported healthy redundancy proves management-plane status only. PSU removal, feed isolation, load transfer and survival are separate service-impacting tests requiring their own authorization, load plan and recovery.
Criteria 1, 2 and 77 are retained without inventing criteria 3-76.
No ipmitool, Redfish, PSU query, authentication, Web capture, PSU removal/disable, feed isolation, power/load action, log clear or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Passive PSU redundancy-group and per-slot health reconciliation
test_case.purpose: Verify the approved PSU redundancy group, policy and every member slot/module/feed health record are consistently reported across IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB Sensor List and BMC Web, with optional Redfish corroboration, without inducing failover.
required_package: SUT/BMC/firmware identity and complete PSU slot/module PN/serial/firmware/feed inventory
Versioned redundancy group, mode/policy, minimum required members and slot/feed membership topology
Exact OEM/IPMI redundancy and per-PSU record IDs/types plus raw/decoded healthy/degraded/lost/failed rules and five-view map
Optional Redfish PowerSubsystem/PowerSupplyRedundancy resource map for supported platforms, approved ipmitool and protected access
Power/platform/BMC owner and human Web/verdict responsibility; separate approved functional-failover plan only if another testcase requires it
test_case.test_command: STRICTLY READ-ONLY PACKAGE-GATED; preserve power/PSU/SEL evidence and freeze the PSU inventory/feed state. Capture complete aligned IB/OOB `sdr elist` and `sensor list` before selecting approved redundancy-group and per-slot records; capture every corresponding Web row. If supported, read the mapped Redfish PowerSubsystem/PowerSupplyRedundancy and member PowerSupply resources as corroboration. Compare topology, mode, member set, raw/decoded health and freshness. Record but do not execute the source AMBIENT/TEMP_MB filters unless an approved alias map validates them. Do not remove/disable a PSU, isolate feeds, alter load/power, clear logs or retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: The configured redundancy group and every PSU member/slot/feed are correctly mapped and report fresh, mutually consistent healthy/redundant state in all supported views; no unrelated thermal record is accepted and no functional-failover claim is made.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact topology/policy/member mapping and complete passive evidence meeting approved state rules. FAIL on missing/extra/duplicate/stale member, wrong slot/feed identity, degraded/lost/failed/unknown redundancy, view mismatch, or use of unrelated thermal evidence. Missing topology/decoder is NOT READY. Functional failover remains untested and cannot inherit PASS; user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Passive reads only; no PSU removal/disable/reset, feed isolation, power cycle, load alteration or redundancy configuration.
Preserve all PSU/power/SEL evidence and protect credentials.
Stop on degraded/lost/failed/unknown redundancy, missing slot, identity mismatch or view disagreement.
No automatic retry or log clearing; preserve the first topology/state.
expected_evidence: Exact source identity and AMBIENT/TEMP_MB conflict record
SUT/BMC plus PSU slot/module/serial/feed and redundancy-group topology/policy
Full timestamped IB/OOB SDR and Sensor-list raw outputs with exits/hashes
Exact group/member raw/decoded status and complete BMC Web evidence
Optional mapped Redfish PowerSupplyRedundancy/member payloads with URIs and timestamps
Passive-versus-failover scope, numbering, no-removal/no-feed-action/no-clear/no-retry audit and verdict
test_case.recovery: On wrong target/topology, access failure, degraded/lost redundancy, missing member or view mismatch, stop passive collection and preserve the first power/SEL state. Close sessions and rotate exposed credentials. Do not touch PSUs/feeds, change load/power, clear logs or retry; escalate exact group, slot, module serial and feed.

source_conflict.reason: The Review layer explicitly rejects unrelated AMBIENT/TEMP_MB filters as executable PSU evidence, preserves them as source defects, and substitutes no guessed OEM name: an approved topology/record map drives complete passive group/member collection.

blocked.reason: Passive redundancy-status semantics, standard corroboration, safety and recovery are defined; OEM record IDs and topology are Project Configuration. Functional failover is explicitly outside this row.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: PSU slot/module/feed inventory, redundancy group/policy/member topology, OEM record IDs/state decoder and supported-view mapping.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED TO PASSIVE PSU REDUNDANCY STATUS; NO IPMITOOL, REDFISH, PSU QUERY, AUTHENTICATION, WEB CAPTURE, PSU/FEED/POWER/LOAD ACTION, LOG CLEAR OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED

external_authorities.title: DMTF Redfish Data Model Specification DSP0268 2025.4
external_authorities.application: Defines redundancy group/member semantics, including active sets and failover/N+m/sharing modes, as a standard corroborating management view.

external_authorities.title: DMTF Redfish Schema Index
external_authorities.application: Identifies PowerSubsystem and PowerSupply schemas and present/absent location modeling; it does not define OEM IPMI record names.

project_authority: Power/platform/BMC owners supply the physical PSU/feed topology, redundancy policy, OEM record map and state decoder; a human validates Web evidence and verdict. Passive status never authorizes or proves physical failover.
